taskSpec.task: Read the topic from staging/test-run/inputs/topic.md, then write a one-paragraph research brief about that topic to staging/test-run/outputs/research.md. Front the artifact with YAML frontmatter declaring `title:` (the topic verbatim).
successCriteria: Artifact has YAML frontmatter with `title:` matching the input topic.
Body contains at least one paragraph of research content.

constraints.scopeLimits: Only files inside staging/test-run/ may be written.
